statements.subject: message
statements.description: The From field of the response MUST equal the From header field of the request.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The Call-ID header field of the response MUST equal the Call-ID header field of the request.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The CSeq header field of the response MUST equal the CSeq field of the request.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The Via header field values in the response MUST equal the Via header field values in the request and MUST maintain the same ordering.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If a request contained a To tag in the request, the To header field in the response MUST equal that of the request.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: However, if the To header field in the request did not contain a tag, the URI in the To header field in the response MUST equal the URI in the To header field; additionally, the UAS MUST add a tag to the To header field in the response (with the exception of the 100 (Trying) response, in which a tag MAY be present).

statements.subject: server
statements.description: However, if the To header field in the request did not contain a tag, the URI in the To header field in the response MUST equal the URI in the To header field; additionally, the UAS MUST add a tag to the To header field in the response (with the exception of the 100 (Trying) response, in which a tag MAY be present).
actions: add locally generated tag to To header field of response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: However, if the To header field in the request did not contain a tag, the URI in the To header field in the response MUST equal the URI in the To header field; additionally, the UAS MUST add a tag to the To header field in the response (with the exception of the 100 (Trying) response, in which a tag MAY be present).

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The same tag MUST be used for all responses to that request, both final and provisional (again excepting the 100 (Trying)).
actions: reuse the same To tag established in the first response for every subsequent non-100 response to the same request
